column1: # Firmware feature matrix for the device-test harness. Columns:
# firmware-prefix<TAB>feature<TAB>supported|unsupported
# Longest matching prefix wins (e.g. "1.6" covers 1.6.1 and 1.6.2);
# unlisted combinations report "unknown" (a harness error inside lifecycle
# scripts; the CI workflow skips non-"supported" entries), so this file is
# the auditable record of what has been validated. Prefixes cover the
# canokey-usbip release catalog: 1.3, 1.5.2, 1.6.1, 1.6.2, 2.0.x, 3.0.x, 3.1.0.
# Grow this file as lifecycle scripts are ported; see README.md.
# OATH
# OATH vendor extensions (KeePassXC-style challenge-response): pinned 3.1
# evidence only (Capability::OathChallengeResponse).
# PIV
# PIV private-key operations gated beyond the lifecycle's 2.0 baseline:
# ML-KEM-768 decapsulation and SM2 agreement are 3.1 evidence; the RNG
# command needs PIV application version 6.0+, and catalog firmware reports
# 5.7.0, so piv-rng is unsupported on every prefix.
# Admin
# Empty-VERIFY status query; the Admin VERIFY dialect exists on every
# cataloged firmware.
# OpenPGP
# OpenPGP lifecycle: cardholder data, touch cache, key generate/export.
# Baseline 2.0, matching the piv-lifecycle gate.
